Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Sangli Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DLSA Sangli Driver recruitment is 12th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 7th pass. Additionally, a valid LMV driving license, a medical fitness certificate, and at least 3 years of driving experience are mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Driver position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Driver post is between 25 years and 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, though not detailed here.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the DLSA Sangli Driver job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by DLSA Sangli.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Driving Test to assess driving skills and a subsequent Interview to evaluate the candidate's suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Driver position?
faq.answer: The Driver position is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Sangli, which is https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/sangli.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Driver post will be determined as per the Minimum Wages Act. Specific figures are not provided in the summary but will be as per prevailing government standards.

faq.question: Q10. Does DLSA Sangli offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates from reserved categories are advised to refer to the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.
